The '''Auril sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] located in this sector included [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]], the [[Auril systems]], and the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]] asteroid field.

When a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] caused the primary of the [[Cron system]] to go [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]], the shockwave destroyed three [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in the sector. The giant gas cloud, the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]], comprised a large majority of the sector.

{{Sec-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[The Horse's Mouth|''Straight from the Horse's Mouth: A Guide to the Tales of the Jedi Universe, Part 1'']], published in [[Star Wars Insider 26|''Star Wars Insider'' 26]] placed the Auril sector in the "Galactic Core".<ref name="Insider 26">{{InsiderCite|26|The Horse's Mouth|Straight from the Horse's Mouth: A Guide to the ''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'' Universe, Part 1}}</ref> However earlier sources like the ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', and later sources such as the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] have placed it in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
